messages.author: ef0b4288ee5b6864
messages.subject: Linking external data to phylogeny
parts:
Hi Yu and all,

I am using ggtree to make a tree with color representing specific value. However, it report error when I try to link tree and data. 

tree<-read.tree('tree.nwk')
full_join(tree,trait,by='node')
error in UseMethod("full_join") : 
  no applicable method for 'full_join' applied to an object of class "phylo"

What should I do?

Thanks 

Bin Lu

messages.author: cec41188340e8212
messages.subject: Re: Linking external data to phylogeny
